$comment: Geometry recipes (pipeline/transit_pipeline/past.py): the North Pacific Coast from OpenHistoricalMap's ways (ohm.py), checked on the USGS sheets of its years (1897-1916) and on later ones where it had closed (1935, 1945).

npc-san-anselmo-manor.note: Cut at San Anselmo and at Manor as the 1941 sheet labels them. OpenHistoricalMap's way here was traced from the 1897 15-minute sheet: on the 1941 sheet it runs 40-60 m north-east of the track, and a straight join of 97 m meets the electric line's track at San Anselmo. It needs a fit (decision 12) or a trace from a better map

npc-manor-point-reyes.note: Cut at Manor (1941 sheet) and at Point Reyes Station (1916 sheet). From Manor to White's Hill (about 2 km) OpenHistoricalMap's way was traced from the 1897 15-minute sheet and is likely tens of metres off, as it is from San Anselmo to Manor; beyond, its ways follow the railroad on the 1914 and 1916 sheets

npc-point-reyes-tomales.note: Cut at Point Reyes Station and at Tomales as the 1916 sheet labels them

npc-tomales-occidental.note: Cut at Tomales (1916 sheet) and at Occidental (1935 sheet); the 1935 sheet, surveyed after the line closed, shows the towns it ran through but not its track

npc-occidental-tyrone.note: Cut at Occidental (1935 sheet) and at Tyrone (1945 sheet)

npc-tyrone-monte-rio.note: Cut at Tyrone and at Monte Rio as the 1945 sheet labels them

npc-monte-rio-sheridan.note: Cut at Monte Rio as the 1945 sheet labels it
